title: Thinner than others and they shed
text: Thinner than others and they shed. These aren't as nice as the photos suggest.  At best, these are adequate towels like you might find in an older, midrange motel. They shed. A lot. Plus, the fabric is thinner than brand name towels in a similar price range. I'm using them as camper towels and they are good enough for that, but not as guest bath towels.
